title: The Companions
description: An ancient brotherhood of warriors from Jorrvaskr in Whiterun, and its secret: the curse of lycanthropy.

items.title: Speak with the Leader of the Companions
items.description: Go to Jorrvaskr and ask Kodlak Whitemane to join the Companions.
tips: The quest often starts on its own if you see Aela and Farkas fighting a giant at a farm near Whiterun.

items.title: Take Up Arms
items.description: Prove yourself sparring with Vilkas, then take his sword to Eorlund Gray-Mane at the Skyforge. After that you're a Companions recruit.
tips: Don't use magic or kill Vilkas in the sparring match, or you'll get a bounty.

items.title: Proving Honor
items.description: Retrieve a fragment of Wuuthrad from Dustman's Cairn with Farkas. There you learn the Circle's secret: the Companions are werewolves.
tips: Do a couple of small Companions jobs first, or Skjor won't give you this quest.

items.title: The Silver Hand
items.description: Undergo the ritual in the Underforge, become a werewolf and strike the Silver Hand werewolf hunters together with Aela.
tips: Lycanthropy cures vampirism and makes you immune to disease.
While you're a werewolf, sleeping doesn't give the Rested bonus.

items.title: Blood's Honor
items.description: Kodlak wants to be free of the beast blood. Kill the Glenmoril witches and bring back their heads.
tips: Keep the spare Glenmoril Witch Heads — you need them for the cure in "Purity".

items.title: Purity of Revenge
items.description: The Silver Hand attacks Jorrvaskr and kills Kodlak. Take revenge at Driftshade Refuge with Vilkas.
items.missable: Kodlak dies as part of the story — his tasks and dialogue are gone.

items.title: Glory of the Dead
items.description: Take the restored Wuuthrad and a witch head to Ysgramor's Tomb, cleanse Kodlak's soul and become Harbinger of the Companions.
tips: You keep Wuuthrad — it's especially effective against elves.
The Shield of Ysgramor lies by his throne.
You can also cure yourself later: bring another witch head to Ysgramor's Tomb — but finish a companion's "Purity" first if you've started it.

options.label: Get cured
options.result: Burn a spare Glenmoril Witch Head in the Flame of the Harbinger — now or later. You lose Beast Form and get the Rested bonus back; Aela will no longer offer "Totems of Hircine".

options.label: Stay a werewolf
options.result: You keep Beast Form and disease immunity, and can collect the Totems of Hircine.

items.missable: Once cured, you lose Beast Form; in the base game you can't get lycanthropy back from the Companions.

items.title: Animal Extermination
items.description: Kill the predators bothering the locals — wolves, bears or sabre cats at the marked location.

items.title: Hired Muscle
items.description: "Persuade" someone who's upset a client: beat them in a fistfight without drawing a weapon.
tips: Don't use weapons or magic, or you'll get a bounty and fail the job.

items.title: Trouble in Skyrim
items.description: Clear out a lair that's troubling a settlement and kill its leader.

items.title: Family Heirloom
items.description: Recover a family heirloom that was carried off into a dungeon.

items.title: Escaped Criminal
items.description: Track down and kill an escaped prisoner.

items.title: Rescue Mission
items.description: Free a captive from an enemy lair and escort them back to their hometown.

items.title: Striking the Heart
items.description: Find a Silver Hand hideout and kill its leader.
items.missable: Only available between "The Silver Hand" and "Blood's Honor": once "Blood's Honor" starts, these quests are gone for good. You can do at most two of the three per playthrough.

items.title: Stealing Plans
items.description: Sneak into a Silver Hand camp and steal their battle plans.
items.missable: Only available between "The Silver Hand" and "Blood's Honor": once "Blood's Honor" starts, these quests are gone for good. You can do at most two of the three per playthrough.

items.title: Retrieval
items.description: Take a fragment of Wuuthrad back from the Silver Hand.
items.missable: Only available between "The Silver Hand" and "Blood's Honor": once "Blood's Honor" starts, these quests are gone for good. You can do at most two of the three per playthrough.

items.title: Purity (Vilkas)
items.description: Like Kodlak, Vilkas wants to be rid of the beast blood. Bring a Glenmoril Witch Head to Ysgramor's Tomb, burn it in the Flame and defeat his wolf spirit.
tips: The quest appears if you ask Vilkas for work after "Glory of the Dead".
If you're out of heads, go to Glenmoril Coven — there are five witches.

items.title: Purity (Farkas)
items.description: Same for Farkas: a Glenmoril Witch Head, the Flame of the Harbinger and a fight with his wolf spirit.
tips: "Purity" can only be done twice — once for each brother. Aela stays a werewolf.

items.title: Dragon Seekers
items.description: Find a dragon lair and slay the dragon.
tips: Requires "Glory of the Dead" and "Dragon Rising" to be complete.

items.title: Totems of Hircine
items.description: Find the three Totems of Hircine and place them in the Underforge — each unlocks a new Beast Form howl (Totem of the Hunt, Totem of Brotherhood, Totem of Fear).
tips: You can switch the active howl at the totem receptacle in the Underforge.
The quest is given three times — once per totem.
items.missable: Werewolves only: once you're cured, Aela won't offer this quest.
